opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or recently displaced, regardless of nationality. Applicants face risk of imminent imprisonment, injury or death. Some need postgraduate qualifications (e.g. PhD) to continue careers; others hold doctorates and seek postdoctoral placements. Applications considered on a rolling basis.
opportunities.summary: A rescue mission for academics at immediate risk of imprisonment, injury or death, providing temporary refuge in universities and research institutions (mostly in the UK) until they can return home. Provides 2- or 3-year awards as standard, with placements ranging from PhD study to postdoctoral research placements. Cara checks applications, helps identify hosts, negotiates placements, allocates additional funding, and assists with visas and practical arrangements for the academic and accompanying family members.
